name: Does an initial consultation with AKN Design Group for a whole-home remodel include a free cost estimate?

mainEntity.name: Does an initial consultation with AKN Design Group for a whole-home remodel include a free cost estimate?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our initial consultation is designed to understand your vision for a whole-home remodel, discuss our integrated design-build process, and determine if AKN Design Group is the right partner for your project. While this consultation provides a general understanding of potential project complexity and budget ranges, a detailed, itemized cost estimate requires more in-depth planning and design work. We focus on providing a managed process where initial discussions lead to a clear scope, enabling an accurate and comprehensive estimate tailored to your specific needs. This ensures our estimates reflect the true value and complexity of your customized renovation.
acceptedAnswer.description: An initial consultation offers a general budget understanding, but a detailed cost estimate for a whole-home remodel requires in-depth planning and design work.
